title: A verdict answers the build it was written after
intention: A verdict opens the PROVED gate only if it was written after the ticket's latest forward BUILDME crossing (or, with none journaled, its latest build commit); an older verdict answers a build that no longer stands and is refused by name.
why: BUILDER measured 2026-10-14 on 6890cf7e4053: the PROVED gate accepted a verdict from 2026-09-02 while a fresh re-run of its criterion 3 was failing. A green opened by a reading of a different build is a hollow green, and a hollow green is worse than a red because a peer leans on it (Law 8). PROVED asserts done, verified in the world now; a verdict that predates the build is narration of a past world (Law 3).
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof of THIS build) and Law 3 (nothing is known until measured, and a measurement measures what stood when it was taken).
how: A Haiku builder needs: (a) the place: the lane the_claiming_chart_is_answered behind _exit_gate/inspect_exit in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py, which composes verdict_contract.unanswered by identity — add the freshness predicate in verdict_contract (its owner; keep unanswered's arity, add a sibling function the lane calls), do not inline a second reading in transitions.py; (b) the verdict's written time is its artifact field (read write_verdict in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py for the field name); (c) the latest forward BUILDME crossing time comes from the ticket's .log.jsonl beside it in CairnCommons/tickets/; (d) proof at cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_a_verdict_answers_the_build_it_was_written_after.py, teeth 1-5 in a fixture commons; tooth 6 reads the live 6890 ticket and its 09-02 verdict path; (e) every PROVED crossing after this lands needs a verdict written after its BUILDME — tickets already mid-sail with old verdicts will bounce once; that is the intended effect.
falsifier: RED if after the build, in a fixture world: (1) a ticket whose latest forward BUILDME crossing is at T and whose only claiming verdict was written before T: the PROVED crossing is refused, the refusal naming the verdict's time and T; (2) the same ticket with a verdict written after T crosses; (3) two verdicts, one stale one fresh: the fresh one is the one the gate reads; (4) a ticket with no BUILDME crossing but build_commits: freshness is bounded by the latest build commit's time; with neither, refused naming both; (5) the gate still runs no instrument and reaches no tree (the existing netns-sealed crossing proof stays green); (6) live: the 6890cf7e4053 2026-09-02 verdict, re-presented against its 2026-10-13/14 BUILDME crossing, is refused. Wrong-intent signal: a verdict written legitimately between hollow seal and PROVED is refused.

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder needs: (a) the place: the lane the_claiming_chart_is_answered behind _exit_gate/inspect_exit in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py, which composes verdict_contract.unanswered by identity — add the freshness predicate in verdict_contract (its owner; keep unanswered's arity, add a sibling function the lane calls), do not inline a second reading in transitions.py; (b) the verdict's written time is its artifact field (read write_verdict in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py for the field name); (c) the latest forward BUILDME crossing time comes from the ticket's .log.jsonl beside it in CairnCommons/tickets/; (d) proof at cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_a_verdict_answers_the_build_it_was_written_after.py, teeth 1-5 in a fixture commons; tooth 6 reads the live 6890 ticket and its 09-02 verdict path; (e) every PROVED crossing after this lands needs a verdict written after its BUILDME — tickets already mid-sail with old verdicts will bounce once; that is the intended effect.

HOW (b) corrected by measurement: a verdict artifact has no time field; its written time is its berth filename stamp verdict-%Y%m%dT%H%M%S-<digest>.json (local time, verdict.py write_verdict), parsed by verdict_contract._verdict_time. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

HOW (c) corrected by measurement: the ticket .log.jsonl carries no crossings; crossings live in component history.json journals. inspector.build_started(ticket, *, roots, root, tickets_dir) -> (buildme_at, commit_times) gathers them: crossings.buildme_crossing(ticket, roots)['at'] (naive local ISO, tools/base public_interface, imported lazily); with none, each of the ticket's build_commits timed by 'git show -s --format=%ct' through the inspector's _git_lines in this repo or the ticket's commons. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.
decisions.step: read the latest forward BUILDME crossing
